edits.new:
Then nothing changes and the user sees MSG-P7-003

  Scenario: AC5 Access refused (exception X1)
    Given a user whose role has no right in capability area Treatment and offer
    When the user calls the offer
    Then the system refuses with 403 before any read of the treatment and the user sees MSG-P4-002

  Scenario: AC6 Plan property invalid (exception X2)
    Given a required plan property is missing or out of its domain
    When the offer is submitted
    Then the system refuses with 422 before any write, names the field with MSG-GEN-001, and nothing changes

  Scenario: AC7 Band refused in the body (exception X3)
    Given the request body names a band column or a band as a stored value
    When the offer is submitted
    Then the request is refused as a contract violation with MSG-GEN-001, and the band is used as a request-context fact only

  Scenario: AC8 Field refused by the library (exception X5)
    Given the decision record library refuses a record field
    When the offer is submitted
    Then nothing changes, the field is named with MSG-P7-009, and the offer stays a draft

  Scenario: AC9 Affordability result absent (exception X6)
    Given the affordability result is absent, superseded or carries no band
    When the offer build is attempted
    Then the offer cannot be built, the case stays in AFFORDABILITY_IN_ACE, the officer is asked to re-run the check, and no band is assumed

  Scenario: AC10 Offer clock reaches validity date (exception X7)
    Given an offer is open and its clock reaches the validity date
    When the durable timer fires
    Then the offer ends, the date is named with MSG-S2-003, and the case move stays with the parent

  Scenario: AC11 Same submit twice (exception X8)
    Given the same submit arrives twice with one Idempotency-Key
    When the second submit arrives
    Then one offer, one decision record and one timer exist, and the first answer is returned

  Scenario: AC12 Counter-offer outside range (rule BR3)
    Given the rwb-case contract mock returns case status OFFER_WITH_CUSTOMER
    Given a case in state OFFER_WITH_CUSTOMER
    When the customer counter-offer is recorded with counter_amount outside the current range
    Then return the case to the officer with the counter-offer and the gap
    Then the offer clock is recalculated from the new validity date
    Then the case moves to WITH_FCR_OFFICER
